scope: Provisional-ID agentic question planning from permitted versioned inventory metadata. Original fixture/answer content is not used.

source.inspection_limit: Question proposals use the inventory endpoint-stage review; original full prompt, output and method limits remain attached. No new runtime or source-data validation implied.

defaults.authoring_unit: One coherent question on independently observed biological inputs; combine bookkeeping and component summaries into its connected analysis.
defaults.required_before_implementation: Freeze independent source lineage, biological sample structure, exact input boundary, method versions, complete artifact schemas and deterministic acceptance. Keep corpus train-only and expected solve time <=30 minutes.
defaults.native_reference: Reference scripts execute the actual required packages; private oracles read supplied inputs. Independently verify identities, algebraic invariants and all required artifacts. No LLM-as-a-judge.
defaults.learned_output_acceptance: Grade complete finite predictions against private observed labels with a frozen metric/criterion. Accept equivalent cluster/topic label permutations. Model uncertainty and counterfactual claims require endpoint-specific checks.
defaults.runtime_boundary: For long original pipelines, explicitly choose a bounded observed-data start boundary. Precomputed alignments or counts cover downstream analysis only; do not claim full raw-data pipeline coverage. GPU/weight-dependent methods and large reference resources remain feasibility questions.
defaults.consolidation: Review overlaps with earlier question cards before implementation. Distinct assays, statistical estimands and named native methods cannot be silently substituted.
